scripts.native:dev: pnpm runtime:build && node scripts/native-sdk-command.mjs dev apps/native-host --yes
scripts.native:dev:clean: cargo run -q -p agent-factory-runtime --bin dev-seed && pnpm native:dev
scripts.build: pnpm schemas:validate && turbo run build && cargo build --workspace --release
scripts.native:build: pnpm build && node scripts/native-sdk-command.mjs build apps/native-host --yes -Doptimize=ReleaseFast
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:native-tooling && pnpm test:native
scripts.validate: pnpm schemas:validate && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm exec native validate apps/native-host/app.zon
